paragraphs.text: God, having of old time spoken unto the fathers in the prophets by divers portions and in divers manners,
paragraphs.original: Πολυμερῶς καὶ πολυτρόπως πάλαι ὁ θεὸς λαλήσας τοῖς πατράσιν ἐν τοῖς προφήταις
paragraphs.translit: Polymerōs kai polytropōs palai ho theos lalēsas tois patrasin en tois prophētais

paragraphs.text: hath at the end of these days spoken unto us in [his] Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds;
paragraphs.original: ἐπʼ ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν τούτων ἐλάλησεν ἡμῖν ἐν υἱῷ, ὃν ἔθηκεν κληρονόμον πάντων, διʼ οὗ καὶ ἐποίησεν τοὺς αἰῶνας·
paragraphs.translit: epʼ eschatou tōn hēmerōn toutōn elalēsen hēmin en hyiō, hon ethēken klēronomon pantōn, diʼ hou kai epoiēsen tous aiōnas·

paragraphs.text: who being the effulgence of his glory, and the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had made purification of sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
paragraphs.original: ὃς ὢν ἀπαύγασμα τῆς δόξης καὶ χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως αὐτοῦ, φέρων τε τὰ πάντα τῷ ῥήματι τῆς δυνάμεως, διʼ αὑτοῦ καθαρισμὸν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ποιησάμενος ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τῆς μεγαλωσύνης ἐν ὑψηλοῖς,
paragraphs.translit: hos ōn apaugasma tēs doxēs kai charaktēr tēs hypostaseōs autou, pherōn te ta panta tō rhēmati tēs dynameōs, diʼ hautou katharismon tōn hamartiōn poiēsamenos ekathisen en dexia tēs megalōsynēs en hypsēlois,

paragraphs.text: having become by so much better than the angels, as he hath inherited a more excellent name than they.
paragraphs.original: τοσούτῳ κρείττων γενόμενος τῶν ἀγγέλων ὅσῳ διαφορώτερον παρʼ αὐτοὺς κεκληρονόμηκεν ὄνομα.
paragraphs.translit: tosoutō kreittōn genomenos tōn angelōn hosō diaphorōteron parʼ autous keklēronomēken onoma.

paragraphs.text: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, This day have I begotten thee?     and again, I will be to him a Father, And he shall be to me a Son?
paragraphs.original: Τίνι γὰρ εἶπέν ποτε τῶν ἀγγέλων· Υἱός μου εἶ σύ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε, καὶ πάλιν· Ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς πατέρα, καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι εἰς υἱόν;
paragraphs.translit: Tini gar eipen pote tōn angelōn· Hyios mou ei sy, egō sēmeron gegennēka se, kai palin· Egō esomai autō eis patera, kai autos estai moi eis hyion;

paragraphs.text: And when he again bringeth in the firstborn into the world he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
paragraphs.original: ὅταν δὲ πάλιν εἰσαγάγῃ τὸν πρωτότοκον εἰς τὴν οἰκουμένην, λέγει· Καὶ προσκυνησάτωσαν αὐτῷ πάντες ἄγγελοι θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hotan de palin eisagagē ton prōtotokon eis tēn oikoumenēn, legei· Kai proskynēsatōsan autō pantes angeloi theou.

paragraphs.text: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels winds, And his ministers a flame a fire:
paragraphs.original: καὶ πρὸς μὲν τοὺς ἀγγέλους λέγει· Ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα, καὶ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ πυρὸς φλόγα·
paragraphs.translit: kai pros men tous angelous legei· Ho poiōn tous angelous autou pneumata, kai tous leitourgous autou pyros phloga·

paragraphs.text: but of the Son [he saith,] Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever; And the sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
paragraphs.original: πρὸς δὲ τὸν υἱόν· Ὁ θρόνος σου ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος, καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς εὐθύτητος ῥάβδος τῆς βασιλείας σου.
paragraphs.translit: pros de ton hyion· Ho thronos sou ho theos eis ton aiōna tou aiōnos, kai hē rhabdos tēs euthytētos rhabdos tēs basileias sou.

paragraphs.text: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
paragraphs.original: ἠγάπησας δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἐμίσησας ἀνομίαν· διὰ τοῦτο ἔχρισέν σε ὁ θεός, ὁ θεός σου, ἔλαιον ἀγαλλιάσεως παρὰ τοὺς μετόχους σου·
paragraphs.translit: ēgapēsas dikaiosynēn kai emisēsas anomian· dia touto echrisen se ho theos, ho theos sou, elaion agalliaseōs para tous metochous sou·

paragraphs.text: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning didst lay the foundation of the       earth, And the heavens are the works of thy hands:
paragraphs.original: καί· Σὺ κατʼ ἀρχάς, κύριε, τὴν γῆν ἐθεμελίωσας, καὶ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σού εἰσιν οἱ οὐρανοί·
paragraphs.translit: kai· Sy katʼ archas, kyrie, tēn gēn ethemeliōsas, kai erga tōn cheirōn sou eisin hoi ouranoi·

paragraphs.text: They shall perish; but thou continuest: And they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
paragraphs.original: αὐτοὶ ἀπολοῦνται, σὺ δὲ διαμένεις· καὶ πάντες ὡς ἱμάτιον παλαιωθήσονται,
paragraphs.translit: autoi apolountai, sy de diameneis· kai pantes hōs himation palaiōthēsontai,

paragraphs.text: And as a mantle shalt thou roll them up, As a garment, and they shall be changed: But thou art the same, And thy years shall not fail.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὡσεὶ περιβόλαιον ἑλίξεις αὐτούς, ὡς ἱμάτιον καὶ ἀλλαγήσονται· σὺ δὲ ὁ αὐτὸς εἶ, καὶ τὰ ἔτη σου οὐκ ἐκλείψουσιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hōsei peribolaion helixeis autous, hōs himation kai allagēsontai· sy de ho autos ei, kai ta etē sou ouk ekleipsousin.

paragraphs.text: But of which of the angels hath he said at any time, Sit thou on my right hand, Till I make thine enemies the footstool of thy feet?
paragraphs.original: πρὸς τίνα δὲ τῶν ἀγγέλων εἴρηκέν ποτε· Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου;
paragraphs.translit: pros tina de tōn angelōn eirēken pote· Kathou ek dexiōn mou heōs an thō tous echthrous sou hypopodion tōn podōn sou;

paragraphs.text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to do service for the sake of them that shall inherit salvation?
paragraphs.original: οὐχὶ πάντες εἰσὶν λειτουργικὰ πνεύματα εἰς διακονίαν ἀποστελλόμενα διὰ τοὺς μέλλοντας κληρονομεῖν σωτηρίαν;
paragraphs.translit: ouchi pantes eisin leitourgika pneumata eis diakonian apostellomena dia tous mellontas klēronomein sōtērian;
